_comment: First-load JS budgets (gzipped bytes), checked by scripts/bundle-budget.mts after `next build`. JSON has no real comment syntax, so the measured baseline lives in _measuredAt/_baseline below instead — see docs/adr/0027-ci-quality-gates.md. Each budget is the baseline plus ~10% headroom, rounded. Re-measure and update both this file and _baseline together if a route's JS genuinely needs to grow; do not just raise the number to make a failing build pass.
